translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on jisi, the Emperor additionally made Jingren director of the secretariat and central protector of the army, establishing his residence as an office;

sentences.zh: 湛加太子詹事。

translations.literal: Zhan was additionally made Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Zhan was additionally made grand tutor of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 湛愈憤怒，使義康毀景仁於帝；

translations.literal: Zhan grew still more angry and had Yikang speak ill of Jingren to the Emperor;
translations.idiomatic: Zhan grew still angrier and had Yikang speak ill of Jingren to the Emperor;

sentences.zh: 帝遇之益隆。

translations.literal: yet the Emperor treated Jingren with ever greater favor.
translations.idiomatic: yet the Emperor treated Jingren with ever greater favor.

sentences.zh: 景仁對親舊歎曰：「引之令入，入便噬人！」

translations.literal: Jingren sighed to relatives and friends, saying: "I brought him in—and once in, he bites!"
translations.idiomatic: Jingren sighed to relatives and friends, saying, "I brought him in—and once in, he bites!"

sentences.zh: 乃稱疾解職，表疏累上。

translations.literal: He then pleaded illness to resign office and submitted memorial after memorial.
translations.idiomatic: He then pleaded illness to resign and submitted memorial after memorial.

sentences.zh: 帝不許，使停家養病。

translations.literal: The Emperor would not agree and had him remain at home to convalesce.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor would not agree and had him remain at home to convalesce.

sentences.zh: 湛議遣人若劫盜者於外殺之，以為帝雖知，當有以解之，不能傷義康至親之愛。

translations.literal: Zhan proposed sending men disguised as robbers to kill Jingren outside, thinking that even if the Emperor learned of it, he could offer some explanation and it would not damage Yikang's love for his close kin.
translations.idiomatic: Zhan proposed sending men disguised as robbers to kill Jingren outside, reasoning that even if the Emperor learned of it, he could offer some explanation and it would not damage Yikang's love for his close kin.

sentences.zh: 帝微聞之，遷護軍府於西掖門外，使近宮禁，故湛謀不行。

translations.literal: The Emperor faintly heard of this and moved the Protector of the Army's headquarters outside the Western Side Gate, close to the palace precincts, so Zhan's plot could not be carried out.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor faintly heard of this and moved the Protector of the Army's headquarters outside the Western Side Gate, close to the palace precincts, so Zhan's plot could not be carried out.

sentences.zh: 義康僚屬及諸附麗湛者，潛相約勒，無敢歷殷氏之門。

translations.literal: Yikang's staff and all who clung to Zhan secretly agreed among themselves that none would dare pass through the Yin family's gate.
translations.idiomatic: Yikang's staff and all who clung to Zhan secretly agreed among themselves that none would dare pass through the Yin family's gate.

sentences.zh: 彭城王主簿沛郡劉敬文父成，未悟其機，詣景仁求郡。

translations.literal: Liu Jingwen of Pei, chief clerk to the Prince of Pengcheng—his father Liu Cheng, not grasping the situation, went to Jingren to request a prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jingwen of Pei, chief clerk to Prince Pengcheng—his father Liu Cheng, not grasping the situation, went to Jingren to request a prefecture.

sentences.zh: 敬文遽往謝湛曰：「老父悖耄，遂就殷鐵干祿。

translations.literal: Jingwen hastened to go apologize to Zhan, saying: "My old father, in his senile folly, went to Yin Tie to seek an office.
translations.idiomatic: Jingwen hastened to apologize to Zhan, saying, "My old father, in his senile folly, went to Yin Tie to seek an office.

sentences.zh: 由敬文暗淺，上負生成，闔門慚懼，無地自處。」

translations.literal: Through Jingwen's own blindness and shallowness, I have failed my parents who gave me life; our whole household is ashamed and fearful, with nowhere to hide our faces."
translations.idiomatic: Through my own blindness and shallowness, I have failed the parents who gave me life; our whole household is ashamed and fearful, with nowhere to hide our faces."

sentences.zh: 唯後將軍司馬庾炳之遊二人之間，皆得其歡心，而密輸忠於朝廷。

translations.literal: Only the major of the rear general Yu Bingzhi moved between the two men's circles, winning the goodwill of both while secretly reporting loyally to the court.
translations.idiomatic: Only the major of the rear general Yu Bingzhi moved between the two men's circles, winning the goodwill of both while secretly reporting loyally to the court.

sentences.zh: 景仁臥家不朝謁，帝常使炳之銜命往來，湛不疑也。

translations.literal: Jingren lay ill at home and did not attend court; the Emperor often sent Bingzhi back and forth bearing orders, and Zhan suspected nothing.
translations.idiomatic: Jingren lay ill at home and did not attend court. The Emperor often sent Bingzhi back and forth bearing orders, and Zhan suspected nothing.

sentences.zh: 炳之，登之之弟也。

translations.literal: Bingzhi was a younger brother of Dengzhi.
translations.idiomatic: Bingzhi was a younger brother of Dengzhi.

sentences.zh: 燕王遣右衛將軍孫德來乞師。

translations.literal: The Yan king sent the General of the Right Guard Sun De to beg for troops.
translations.idiomatic: The Northern Yan king sent General of the Right Guard Sun De to beg for military aid.

sentences.zh: 五月，庚申，魏主進宜都公穆壽爵為王，汝陰公長孫道生為上黨王，宜城公奚斤為恆農王，廣陵公樓伏連為廣陵王；

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on gengshen, the Wei ruler advanced the Duke of Yidu Mu Shou to prince, the Duke of Ruyin Zhangsun Daosheng to Prince of Shangdang, the Duke of Yicheng Xi Jin to Prince of Hengnong, and the Duke of Guangling Lou Fulian to Prince of Guangling;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengshen, the Northern Wei emperor advanced Duke of Yidu Mu Shou to prince, Duke of Ruyin Zhangsun Daosheng to Prince of Shangdang, Duke of Yicheng Xi Jin to Prince of Hengnong, and Duke of Guangling Lou Fulian to Prince of Guangling;

sentences.zh: 加壽征東大將軍。

translations.literal: Shou was given the additional title of General Who Conquers the East.
translations.idiomatic: Shou was given the additional title General Who Conquers the East.

sentences.zh: 壽辭曰：「臣祖父崇所以得效功前朝，流福於後者，由梁眷之忠也。

translations.literal: Shou declined, saying: "The reason my grandfather Chong was able to render merit to the former dynasty and leave blessings for posterity was Liang Juan's loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: Shou declined, saying, "The reason my grandfather Chong was able to render merit to the former dynasty and leave blessings for posterity was Liang Juan's loyalty.

sentences.zh: 今眷元勳未錄，而臣獨弈世受賞，心實愧之。」

translations.literal: Now Juan's founding merit has not been recorded, while I alone receive rewards generation after generation—my heart is truly ashamed."
translations.idiomatic: Now Juan's founding merit has not been recorded, while I alone receive rewards generation after generation—my heart is truly ashamed."

sentences.zh: 魏主悅，求眷後，得其孫，賜爵郡公。

translations.literal: The Wei ruler was pleased, sought out Juan's descendants, found his grandson, and granted him the rank of Duke of a Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was pleased, sought out Juan's descendants, found his grandson, and granted him the rank of Duke of a Commandery.

sentences.zh: 壽，觀之子也。

translations.literal: Shou was a son of Guan.
translations.idiomatic: Shou was a son of Guan.

sentences.zh: 龜茲、疏勒、烏孫、悅般、渴槃阤、鄯善、焉耆、車師、粟持九國入貢於魏。

translations.literal: The nine states of Kucha, Shule, Wusun, Yueban, Kapisi, Shanshan, Yanqi, Cheshi, and Sute presented tribute to Wei.
translations.idiomatic: The nine states of Kucha, Shule, Wusun, Yueban, Kapisi, Shanshan, Yanqi, Cheshi, and Sute presented tribute to Northern Wei.

sentences.zh: 魏主以漢世雖通西域，有求則卑辭而來，無求則驕慢不服。

translations.literal: The Wei ruler held that although the Han dynasty had communicated with the Western Regions, when they had requests they came with humble words, and when they had none they were arrogant and would not submit.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor held that although the Han dynasty had communicated with the Western Regions, when they wanted something they came with humble words, and when they wanted nothing they were arrogant and would not submit.

sentences.zh: 蓋自知去中國絕遠，大兵不能至故也。

translations.literal: This was because they knew themselves to be utterly distant from China and that great armies could not reach them.
translations.idiomatic: This was because they knew themselves to be utterly distant from China and that great armies could not reach them.

sentences.zh: 今報使往來，徒為勞費，終無所益，欲不遣使。

translations.literal: Now envoys going back and forth in reply would only waste labor and expense with no benefit in the end; he wished not to send envoys.
translations.idiomatic: Now reciprocal envoys would only waste labor and expense with no benefit in the end; he wished not to send envoys.

sentences.zh: 有司固請，以為：「九國不憚險遠，慕義入貢，不宜拒絕，以抑將來。」

translations.literal: The responsible officials firmly petitioned, holding: "The nine states did not fear hardship and distance but came admiring righteousness to present tribute; they should not be refused, lest future comers be discouraged."
translations.idiomatic: The responsible officials firmly petitioned, holding, "The nine states did not fear hardship and distance but came admiring righteousness to present tribute; they should not be refused, lest future comers be discouraged."

sentences.zh: 乃遣使者王恩生等二十輩使西域。

translations.literal: Thereupon he sent the envoys Wang Ensheng and twenty others on a mission to the Western Regions.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he sent envoys Wang Ensheng and twenty others on a mission to the Western Regions.

sentences.zh: 恩生等始度流沙，為柔然所執，恩生所敕連可汗，持魏節不屈。

translations.literal: Ensheng and the others had just crossed the drifting sands when they were seized by the Rouran; Ensheng saw Khan Chilelian and, holding the Wei credentials, would not yield.
translations.idiomatic: Ensheng and the others had just crossed the drifting sands when they were seized by the Rouran; Ensheng saw Khan Chilelian and, holding the Northern Wei credentials, would not yield.

sentences.zh: 魏主聞之，切責敕連，敕連乃遣恩生等還。

translations.literal: When the Wei ruler heard of it, he sternly rebuked Chilelian, and Chilelian then sent Ensheng and the others back.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor heard of it, he sternly rebuked Chilelian, and Chilelian then sent Ensheng and the others back.

sentences.zh: 竟不能達西域。

translations.literal: In the end they could not reach the Western Regions.
translations.idiomatic: In the end they could not reach the Western Regions.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，魏主如雲中。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, the Wei ruler went to Yunzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, the Northern Wei emperor went to Yunzhong.

sentences.zh: 六月，甲午，魏主以時和年豐，嘉瑞沓臻，詔大酺五日，遍祭百神，用答天貺。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jiawu, the Wei ruler, because the seasons were harmonious and the year abundant and auspicious omens arrived in succession, ordered a great feast of five days and sacrifices to the hundred spirits everywhere, to respond to Heaven's gift.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiawu, because the seasons were harmonious, the harvest abundant, and auspicious omens arrived in succession, the Northern Wei emperor ordered a great feast of five days and sacrifices to the hundred spirits everywhere, to respond to Heaven's gift.

sentences.zh: 丙午，高句麗王璉遣使入貢於魏，且請國諱。

translations.literal: On bingwu, the King of Goguryeo Lian sent envoys to present tribute to Wei and also requested the state's taboo names.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, King Lian of Goguryeo sent envoys to present tribute to Northern Wei and also requested the state's taboo names.

sentences.zh: 魏主使錄帝系及諱以與之；

translations.literal: The Wei ruler had the imperial genealogy and taboo names recorded and given to them;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had the imperial genealogy and taboo names recorded and given to them;

sentences.zh: 拜璉都督遼海諸軍事、征東將軍、遼東郡公、高句麗王。

translations.literal: and appointed Lian Commander-in-Chief of all military affairs in Liaohai, General Who Conquers the East, Duke of Liaodong Commandery, and King of Goguryeo.
translations.idiomatic: and appointed Lian commander of all military affairs in Liaohai, General Who Conquers the East, Duke of Liaodong Commandery, and King of Goguryeo.

sentences.zh: 璉，釗之曾孫也。

translations.literal: Lian was a great-grandson of Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: Lian was a great-grandson of Zhao.

sentences.zh: 戊申，魏主命驃騎大將軍樂平王丕、鎮東大將軍徒河屈垣等帥騎四萬伐燕。

translations.literal: On wushen, the Wei ruler ordered the General of Agile Cavalry, the Prince of Leping Pi, the General Who Pacifies the East Qu Yuan of Tuhe, and others to lead forty thousand horsemen to attack Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, the emperor ordered General of Agile Cavalry Prince of Leping Pi, General Who Pacifies the East Qu Yuan of Tuhe, and others to lead forty thousand horsemen to attack Yan.

sentences.zh: 揚州諸郡大水，己酉，運徐、豫、南兗谷以賑之。

translations.literal: The commanderies of Yangzhou suffered great floods; on jiyou, grain from Xu, Yu, and Southern Yan was transported to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: The commanderies of Yangzhou suffered great floods; on jiyou, grain from Xu, Yu, and Southern Yan was transported to relieve them.

sentences.zh: 揚州西曹主簿沈亮建議，以為酒糜谷而不足療饑，請權禁止；

translations.literal: Shen Liang, Chief Clerk of the Western Section of Yangzhou, proposed that wine wasted grain and was insufficient to cure famine, and requested a provisional ban;
translations.idiomatic: Shen Liang, Chief Clerk of the Western Section of Yangzhou, proposed that wine wasted grain and could not relieve famine, and requested a provisional ban;

sentences.zh: 詔從之。

translations.literal: an edict assented.
translations.idiomatic: an edict assented.

sentences.zh: 亮，林子之子也。

translations.literal: Liang was a son of Linzi.
translations.idiomatic: Liang was a son of Linzi.

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，魏主畋於稒陽。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, the Wei ruler hunted at Fuyang.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, the Northern Wei emperor hunted at Fuyang.

sentences.zh: 己卯，魏樂平王丕等至和龍。

translations.literal: On jimao, the Wei Prince of Leping Pi and others reached Helong.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Prince of Leping Pi and the other Northern Wei commanders reached Helong.

sentences.zh: 燕王以牛酒犒軍，獻甲三千。

translations.literal: The Yan king presented cattle and wine to comfort the army and offered three thousand suits of armor.
translations.idiomatic: The Yan king presented cattle and wine to comfort the army and offered three thousand suits of armor.

sentences.zh: 屈垣責其不送侍子，掠男女六千口而還。

translations.literal: Qu Yuan rebuked him for not sending a hostage prince and carried off six thousand men and women on the return.
translations.idiomatic: Qu Yuan rebuked him for not sending a hostage prince and carried off six thousand men and women on the return march.

sentences.zh: 八月，丙戌，魏主如河西。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on bingxu, the Wei ruler went to Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on bingxu, the Northern Wei emperor went to Hexi.

sentences.zh: 九月，甲戌，還宮。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jiaxu, he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiaxu, he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 魏左僕射河間公安原，恃寵驕恣；

translations.literal: The Wei Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, Anyuan of Hejian, relied on favor and was arrogant and unrestrained;
translations.idiomatic: Left Vice Director Anyuan of Hejian relied on imperial favor and was arrogant and unrestrained;

sentences.zh: 或告原謀為逆，冬，十月，癸卯，原坐族誅。

translations.literal: someone reported that Anyuan plotted rebellion; in winter, the tenth month, on guimao, Anyuan was executed and his clan destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: someone reported that Anyuan plotted rebellion; in winter, the tenth month, on guimao, Anyuan was executed and his clan destroyed.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，魏主如定州；

translations.literal: On jiachen, the Wei ruler went to Dingzhou;
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, the Northern Wei emperor went to Dingzhou;

sentences.zh: 十一月，乙丑，如冀州；

translations.literal: in the eleventh month, on yichou, he went to Jizhou;
translations.idiomatic: in the eleventh month, on yichou, he went to Jizhou;

sentences.zh: 己巳，敗於廣州；

translations.literal: on jisi, he hunted at Guangzhou;
translations.idiomatic: on jisi, he hunted at Guangzhou;

sentences.zh: 丙子，如鄴。

translations.literal: on bingzi, he went to Ye.
translations.idiomatic: on bingzi, he went to Ye.

sentences.zh: 魏人數伐燕，燕日危蹙，上下憂懼。

translations.literal: The Wei attacked Yan again and again; Yan grew daily more desperate, and above and below were anxious and afraid.
translations.idiomatic: The Northern Wei attacked Yan again and again; Yan grew daily more desperate, and court and people alike were anxious and afraid.

sentences.zh: 太常楊□昏復勸燕王速遣太子入侍。

translations.literal: The Grandee of Splendid Happiness Yang [Hui] again urged the Yan king quickly to send the crown prince to attend at court as hostage.
translations.idiomatic: Grandee of Splendid Happiness Yang Hui again urged the Yan king quickly to send the crown prince to the Northern Wei court as hostage.

sentences.zh: 燕王曰：「吾未忍為此。

translations.literal: The Yan king said: "I cannot yet bear to do this.
translations.idiomatic: The Yan king said, "I cannot yet bear to do this.

sentences.zh: 若事急，且東依高麗以圖後舉。」

translations.literal: If matters grow urgent, for the time being we shall rely on Goguryeo to the east and plan a later effort."
translations.idiomatic: If matters grow urgent, for the time being we shall rely on Goguryeo to the east and plan a later effort."

sentences.zh: □昏曰：「魏舉天下以擊一隅，理無不克。

translations.literal: Yang [Hui] said: "Wei is mobilizing the whole realm to strike one corner—by reason it cannot fail to conquer.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Hui said, "Northern Wei is mobilizing the whole realm to strike one corner—by reason it cannot fail to conquer.

sentences.zh: 高麗無信，始雖相親，終恐為變。」

translations.literal: Goguryeo is faithless; though at first they seem friendly, in the end I fear they will turn against us."
translations.idiomatic: Goguryeo is faithless; though at first they seem friendly, in the end I fear they will turn against us."

sentences.zh: 燕王不聽，密遣尚書陽伊請迎於高麗。

translations.literal: The Yan king would not listen and secretly sent the Director of the Imperial Secretariat Yang Yi to request a welcome from Goguryeo.
translations.idiomatic: The Yan king would not listen and secretly sent Director of the Imperial Secretariat Yang Yi to request aid from Goguryeo.

sentences.zh: 丹陽尹蕭摹之上言：「佛化被於中國，已歷四代，形像塔寺，所在千數。

translations.literal: Xiao Mo, Intendant of Danyang, submitted a memorial: "Buddhist teaching has spread over China for four dynasties already; images, pagodas, and temples number in the thousands wherever one goes.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Mo, Intendant of Danyang, submitted a memorial: "Buddhist teaching has spread over China for four dynasties already; images, pagodas, and temples number in the thousands wherever one goes.

sentences.zh: 自頃以來，情敬浮末，不以精誠為至，更為奢競為重，材竹銅彩，糜損無極；

translations.literal: In recent times devotional feeling has grown superficial, sincerity is no longer held supreme, and extravagant competition is prized instead; timber, bamboo, bronze, and colored ornament are wasted without limit;
translations.idiomatic: In recent times devotional feeling has grown superficial, sincerity is no longer held supreme, and extravagant competition is prized instead; timber, bamboo, bronze, and colored ornament are wasted without limit;

sentences.zh: 無關神祇，有累人事，不為之防，流遁未息。

translations.literal: this does nothing for the spirits, yet burdens human affairs; if it is not checked, the drain will not cease.
translations.idiomatic: this does nothing for the spirits, yet burdens human affairs; if it is not checked, the drain will not cease.

sentences.zh: 請自今欲鑄銅像及造塔寺者，皆當列言，須報乃得為之。」

translations.literal: I request that from now on anyone wishing to cast bronze images or build pagodas and temples must report in detail and may do so only after approval."
translations.idiomatic: I request that from now on anyone wishing to cast bronze images or build pagodas and temples must report in detail and may do so only after approval."

sentences.zh: 詔從之。

translations.literal: An edict assented.
translations.idiomatic: An edict assented.

sentences.zh: 摹之，思話從叔也。

translations.literal: Mo was a cousin on the father's side of Sihua.
translations.idiomatic: Mo was a cousin of Sihua on the father's side.

sentences.zh: 魏秦州刺史薛謹擊吐沒骨，滅之。

translations.literal: Xue Jin, Inspector of Qinzhou of Wei, attacked Tumoguli and destroyed them.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Jin, Northern Wei inspector of Qinzhou, attacked Tumoguli and destroyed them.

sentences.zh: 楊難當釋楊保宗之囚，使鎮童亭。

translations.literal: Yang Nandang released Yang Baozong from prison and had him garrison Tongting.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Nandang released Yang Baozong from prison and had him garrison Tongting.
